final: WITH invoice_avgs AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS ratio_avg FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(ratio_avg) AS overall_ratio_avg FROM invoice_avgs), kept AS (SELECT i.avg_product_cost, i.ratio_avg, i.ratio_avg - o.overall_ratio_avg AS ratio_difference FROM invoice_avgs i JOIN overall_avg o ON o.overall_ratio_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE i.ratio_avg > o.overall_ratio_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_product_cost), AVG(ratio_avg), AVG(ratio_difference) FROM kept
